title: Save the full raw provider payload for every bank-imported transaction
description: Pluggy mapping (api/src/connections/adapters/pluggy/index.ts toAggregatedTransaction) keeps only id/account/description/amount/date/cleared; everything else (installments, merchant, PIX/payment data, card metadata, raw status, category, descriptionRaw...) is dropped.
notes:
Implemented: AggregatedTransaction.raw (Pluggy passes the passthrough object through), migration 0105_connection_transaction_raw.sql (connection_transactions.raw_payload jsonb, raw_received_at timestamptz) + MIGRATION_SIGNATURES, sync writes raw on insert and refreshes it on every pull of a shadowed row (blocked/duplicate/updated) without touching updated_at or user fields, getImportMetadata(db, transactionId) in connections/ledger-reads.ts exported from the barrel for budget-hebq. tsc/eslint clean, api bun test 1194 pass 0 fail. Note: :5432 rejects postgres:postgres here, tests ran on compose :55432 (BUDGET_TEST_PG_BASE); test DB dropped.
Included in tk/budget-1iym (rebased on hebq): raw refresh moved inside 1iym's per-row SAVEPOINT; all package tests pass on the combined branch (c186f6f).
landed outside tk close at c225004 (branch tk/budget-lkor merged into main by hand)
Merged to main (c225004): migration 0105 raw_payload/raw_received_at on connection_transactions, Pluggy raw passed through the port, written on insert and refreshed every pull; getImportMetadata. api 1207 pass on combined tip. User approved merge+deploy.
acceptance_criteria: Additive migration storing the raw provider transaction JSON per imported row; the adapter passes the raw object through the port; sync writes it on insert and refreshes it on every pull (rows imported before get it on their next sync). Tests.

commits.subject: connections: save the raw provider payload for every bank-imported transaction (budget-lkor)
